## Activity

During March 2023, East City Eye Clinic recorded 205 captures. This report summarises the capture activity, image quality, and grading outcomes recorded for the month. The activity total provides the overall number of captures available for review and supports comparison with the image-quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Of the 205 captures, 6 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.9 per cent. These captures could not be included in grading, and the rate indicates the proportion of the monthly activity affected by image quality. The image-quality result is reported separately to distinguish it from the findings among captures that could be graded.

## Grading

Grading identified 38 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. Together, the grading count and median lag provide the key information on the month’s reviewed outcomes and the time taken for grading. The figures for March 2023 are recorded for East City Eye Clinic as 205 captures, 6 ungradable captures, an ungradable rate of 2.9 per cent, 38 referable results, and a median lag of 2.
